## Delivered / file mappings

- supabase/migrations/20261024001000_work_items.sql: requested six tables work_items/record_grants/status_definitions/audit_events/idempotency_keys/outbox_jobs plus four fixed children deliverables/tasks/requests/announcements. Composite organization/term/kind FKs, deferred exactly-one-child checks, immutable child identity/status semantics/history/original due identity, editable-row actor/time/version stamps. Parent work version is the command concurrency token; child stamps track local body edits. No generic entity/EAV platform or governed finance/approval payload.
- Ordinary summaries are column-limited; parent IDs/private bodies are not exposed through summary SELECT. Restricted items, child bodies and audits require exact detail scope. Member/unit/invitation grants and record-scoped roles never inherit parent/sibling/term/unit privileges. read_work_parent independently checks child and parent. Same-term role work_id and invitation grant FKs replace deferred placeholders. Current membership/unit/role/guest-email/sponsor/revoke/expiry rechecked. Work/audit name snapshots preserve attribution without private profile joins.
- create_work_item/update_work_item/grant_work_access/revoke_work_access derive actor and enforce bounded draft rules, expected version, immutable actor/command/key result convention, advisory first-key/work-row locks and atomic redacted audit/outbox writes. Repeat returns exact earlier receipt; changed payload fails. UTC-normalized expiry prevents timezone-dependent fingerprint changes. Grant withdrawal allowed on otherwise authorized frozen/submitted work. Direct status/owner/approval/child/grant writes denied. No outbox dispatch worker or external send.
- src/lib/commands.ts and commands.test.ts: four typed adapters, target-principal union, real SDK RPCs, preserved request/version arguments, validated receipts and transparent sanitized structured errors. No hidden retries/optimistic fake success/generic entity dispatcher.
- P05/P06 integration: effective sponsor counts/redemption reflect actual record grants; new/renewed invitations remain empty. read_guest_contacts exposes only active owner name/exact-school organization route of specifically shared work; no private profile fields/full directory. Guest contact adapter/editor and sponsor list render explicit scopes safely; encoded mail route, scope removal on reload, existing design spacing preserved. No new work UI/record-list page (P08 owns that).
- supabase/tests/work_access.test.sql + scripts/test-work-access.cjs, package test:work-access; generated catalog/types now **25tables/306columns/25public functions**. P05/P06 runner evidence wording updated to current schema. docs/work-items.md owns detailed interfaces; buildCONTRACTS/permissions/guests/people/README updated without erasing prior external gates.
